title: Healthcare assistant
entry_route_no_quals: Volunteer in the NHS to get healthcare experience, or start as a trainee care assistant in a care home and work towards a healthcare qualification on the job.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for a Healthcare Support Worker Level 2 Intermediate Apprenticeship, or take a college course in health and social care, which usually includes work placements.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a Senior Healthcare Support Worker Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship.
entry_route_graduate: No degree is needed: apply for healthcare assistant jobs or a Senior Healthcare Support Worker Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship, and show you understand how the NHS values apply to the work.
entry_route_career_changer: Use your people and customer service skills to apply for trainee care assistant jobs in a care home, and complete your healthcare qualification while you work.

title: Care worker
entry_route_no_quals: Apply for care worker jobs directly, as many employers give on-the-job training to people with the right personal qualities, or volunteer with a care home, charity or hospice first.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for an Adult Care Worker Level 2 Intermediate Apprenticeship, or take a college course in care or health and social care.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a Lead Adult Care Worker Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship with a care organisation or the NHS.
entry_route_graduate: No degree is needed: apply for care worker jobs directly with on-the-job training, or for a Lead Adult Care Worker Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship.
entry_route_career_changer: Apply for care worker jobs directly and train on the job; time spent caring for someone you know also counts as experience in a caring role.

title: Software developer
entry_route_no_quals: If you're aged 16 to 21, apply for a Software and Data Level 2 Foundation Apprenticeship, which needs no qualifications; at any age you can start learning programming languages with online learning resources.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for a Software Development Technician Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship, or take a college course in programming or principles of coding.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a Software Developer Level 4 Higher Apprenticeship, or a degree in computer science, software development or software engineering.
entry_route_graduate: Apply for a graduate training scheme with an IT company; many are open to graduates of any subject, not just computing.
entry_route_career_changer: Retrain on an intensive course, as one former NHS nurse did with an 8-month full-time tech academy course, then apply for software developer roles.

title: Data analyst
entry_route_no_quals: If you're aged 16 to 21, apply for a Software and Data Level 2 Foundation Apprenticeship, which needs no qualifications, or volunteer with community organisations and charities to build data skills.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for a Data Technician Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship, or take a college course in maths, statistics or computing.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a Data Analyst Level 4 Higher Apprenticeship, or a degree in statistics, maths, economics, operational research or psychology.
entry_route_graduate: Apply for graduate analyst jobs, or join the Government Statistical Service through the Civil Service Fast Stream if your degree is in statistics, maths or economics.
entry_route_career_changer: Move across with a Data Analyst Level 4 Higher Apprenticeship, as one finance analyst did; the Government Statistical Service also recruits people with relevant experience.

title: Electrician
entry_route_no_quals: Start a Level 2 electrical installation course at college, free for eligible adults through Free Courses for Jobs, to help you get onto an apprenticeship or a trainee position.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for an Installation and Maintenance Electrician or Domestic Electrician Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship with an electrical company; apprenticeships are open to all ages.
entry_route_level3: Apply for an Installation and Maintenance Electrician Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship, or train as an electrician through an apprenticeship in the armed forces.
entry_route_graduate: Apply directly for electrician jobs if your qualifications and experience are in a related field such as building services or electrical engineering; otherwise start an electrician apprenticeship.
entry_route_career_changer: If you've already done electrical work, get your skills recognised through the Experienced Worker Assessment (it needs 3 or 5 years' experience); otherwise start an apprenticeship, which is open to all ages.
skills: Electrical installation;Using tools and equipment;Construction knowledge;Maths;Health and safety;Customer service

title: Wind turbine technician
entry_route_no_quals: Start a Level 2 engineering course at college, free for eligible adults through Free Courses for Jobs, which could help you get a trainee job with a wind turbine engineering company.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for a Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship such as Engineering Maintenance Technician or Maintenance Operations Engineering Technician; these take 3 to 4 years.
entry_route_level3: Apply for an Engineering Technician Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship, or a foundation degree, HND or degree in renewable energy, electrical or mechanical engineering.
entry_route_graduate: Apply directly for wind turbine technician jobs if your degree is in electrical or mechanical engineering; your employer will arrange the safety training needed to work on turbines.
entry_route_career_changer: Apply directly if you have electrical or mechanical engineering experience from another industry or the armed forces; you'll also need a full driving licence and turbine safety training.
skills: Wind turbine maintenance;Engineering knowledge;Using tools and equipment;Problem solving;Maths;Teamwork

title: Heat pump engineer
entry_route_no_quals: If you're aged 16 to 21, apply for a Building Services Engineering Level 2 Foundation Apprenticeship, which needs no qualifications, or take a plumbing and heating college course, free for eligible adults through Free Courses for Jobs.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for a Low Carbon Heating Technician Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship, or take a college course in plumbing and heating.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a Low Carbon Heating Technician or Heat Network Maintenance Technician Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship.
entry_route_graduate: No degree is needed: train as a plumber, heating and ventilation engineer or gas service technician, then add heat pump training, which usually lasts 3 to 5 days.
entry_route_career_changer: If you already work as a plumber, gas service technician or heating and ventilation engineer, add heat pump installation training, which usually lasts 3 to 5 days.
skills: Plumbing and heating;Using tools and equipment;Construction knowledge;Maths;Teamwork;Customer service

title: Welder
entry_route_no_quals: Take a welding qualification at college, such as a Level 2 welding award, then apply for jobs as a trainee welder.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for a General Welder Level 2 Intermediate Apprenticeship, or take a college course in fabrication and welding engineering.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a Pipe Welder or Plate Welder Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship; welding apprenticeships take 2 to 4 years.
entry_route_graduate: If you work in engineering, take a welding or inspection course through The Welding Institute (TWI); otherwise start with a college welding qualification and apply for trainee welder jobs.
entry_route_career_changer: Apply directly for welding jobs if you have welding experience and certificates from pipe fitting, engineering construction, marine engineering or steel fabrication; many jobs also need a CCNSG safety passport.
skills: Welding;Fabrication;Engineering knowledge;Maths;Using tools and equipment;Health and safety

title: Maintenance fitter
entry_route_no_quals: Start as an engineering operative or trainee craftsperson and train on the job to become a fitter; if you're aged 16 to 21, an Engineering and Manufacturing Level 2 Foundation Apprenticeship needs no qualifications.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for an Engineering Fitter Level 2 Intermediate Apprenticeship, or take a college course in engineering or mechanical or electrical engineering.
entry_route_level3: Apply for an Engineering Maintenance Technician or Maintenance Operations Engineering Technician Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship.
entry_route_graduate: Apply directly for maintenance fitter jobs if you have qualifications and experience in mechanical or electrical engineering; otherwise start as a trainee and train on the job.
entry_route_career_changer: Apply directly if you have maintenance experience in mechanical engineering, pipefitting, welding or electrical engineering; many jobs also ask for a CCNSG safety passport.
skills: Using tools and equipment;Engineering knowledge;Problem solving;Teamwork;Health and safety;Digital skills

title: Large goods vehicle driver
entry_route_no_quals: Get a non-driving job with a transport operator, as your employer might support you through HGV licence training, or apply for a free HGV Skills Bootcamp if you're 19 or over with a full car driving licence.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for a Large Goods Vehicle (LGV) Driver C and E Level 2 Intermediate Apprenticeship, which takes around 1 year.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a Large Goods Vehicle (LGV) Driver C and E Level 2 Intermediate Apprenticeship, or train with a specialist provider for your HGV licence and Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC).
entry_route_graduate: Train with a specialist provider for your HGV licence and Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC), or apply for an HGV Skills Bootcamp, which ends with a guaranteed job interview.
entry_route_career_changer: Apply for an HGV Skills Bootcamp (up to 16 weeks, for people 19 or over with a full car driving licence); you finish with a category C or CE licence and a guaranteed job interview.
